text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. The main goal is to make the code easier to read and understand. When developers refactor, they clean up messy sections, remove duplicate parts, and give variables clearer names. This makes the code simpler for everyone on the team to work with. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which is the extra work that builds up when code is written quickly without proper care. By spending time on refactoring, teams can fix problems early and keep their projects healthy in the long run.
